text:
Samira K.: Heads up — Ardent Labs renewal is creeping up in ~6 weeks and we just surfaced a sharp usage drop. 30d active API calls down ~65% vs prior period after their ML lead left. Procurement pinged asking about competitive eval (they mentioned GenForge pilot). :warning: Need triage and a short playbook.
Diego R.: Yikes. Do we have the exact cohort and top-3 routes impacted? Can someone paste the last 30d token/day chart? :eyes:
Samira K.: Quick snapshot from the console:
```
30d MAU: 1,200 -> 420 (-65%)
Top routes: /generate (down 72%), /embeddings (down 48%)
Error rate unchanged (0.8%)
Avg lat p95: 320ms (no big change)
```
Samira K.: They flagged a competitor pilot + internal team reshuffle (new PM + procurement review). Champion still supportive but quiet. They asked for cost comparisons and a reliability note.
Priya Nair: Ok — high level triage:
• Outreach: schedule a customer health call with champion + new PM (owner: Samira)
• Competitive: compile a one-page comparison vs GenForge (owner: Nate)
• Cost/product: run a model selection & quantization bake-off for their workload (owner: Eng — @Diego to coordinate)
• Enablement: propose 1-hr workshop for new PM + engs covering integration + cost levers (owner: Priya)
Nate Liu: I'll own the competitor one-pager. Will include: latency, per-token unit cost, model parity notes, and migration friction. ETA 48h.
Diego R.: I'll run job to run sample throughput on their top prompt set and test a smaller quantized model. Need their sample prompts — Samira can you request? Eng-bot will create a ticket.
eng-bot: Ticket created — INF-2019: "Ardent Labs: quantization & perf check" assigned to Diego. Due in 3 business days.
Olivia - CS Manager: Agree with play. Also suggest an exec 15-min check-in with their VP of Data before renewal to re-establish sponsor. I can join if you want.
Samira K.: I'll request the sample prompt set and schedule the health call for tomorrow EOD. Olivia — a 15-min exec nudge sounds good, thanks.
Priya Nair: For the enablement workshop, use this checklist: integration walkthrough, cost levers (batching/caching/quantization), rollout plan, and regen cases. Keep it focused to avoid info overload.
Nate Liu: I'll include a short migration risk appendix — how much work swapping embeddings model vs generator model.
Diego R.: If we can show a 30-40% cost reduction with similar quality via quantization + batching, that's a strong save argument for them.
Samira K.: Action items & owners:
• Request sample prompts + confirm champion availability (Samira) — due today EOD
• One-pager competitor + migration appendix (Nate) — due in 48h
• Quant/perf job + initial results (Diego) — due in 3 business days
• Schedule enablement workshop + exec nudge (Priya + Olivia) — schedule by EOD tomorrow
• Prep renewal playbook + proposed short-term discount (Samira + Olivia + RevOps) — draft in 72h
Olivia - CS Manager: I'll loop in Sales + RevOps for the discount approval. Please CC me on the health call invite.
Samira K.: Adding a private thread for notes. If anyone hears procurement timelines or exec feedback, paste here. Thanks team :pray:
Diego R.: Noted — will post perf artifacts and configs in the ticket when ready.
Nate Liu: One-pager draft will be in the thread and shared drive link.
Samira K.: Great. Next sync after the health call — update last_message_ts when we post results.
